chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Asbaat, from a slave of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I saw Abu Al-Hasan Al-Awwal (peace be upon him) call for a camel and sacrifice it. So when the slaughterers struck its jugular veins, it fell to the ground, and they exposed a part of its hump. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Cut it, eat from it, and feed (others).'
So when they fall down, eat from them and feed.

key_terms.بَدَنَة: Camel (specifically a female camel used for sacrifice)
key_terms.فَإِذا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوبُها: So when their sides fall down (referring to the camel falling after slaughter)
key_terms.نَحَرَهَا: He sacrificed it (by cutting the throat)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on eating and distributing meat from a sacrificed camel according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Hadi (AS) illustrates the practical application of Qurbani, emphasizing the immediate distribution of meat as a communal act of worship. It highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the Prophet's and Imams' adherence to Quranic injunctions regarding sacrificial animals, reinforcing the spiritual and social dimensions of charity. The event serves as a living exegesis of the ritual, connecting the physical act of slaughter with divine command.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, 
(It has been narrated) from a slave of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having said, ‘I saw Abu Al-Hassanasws the 1st calling for his camel, so he sacrificed it. So, when the camel-slayers struck its veins, it fell upon the ground, and something from its hump was exposed. Heasws said: ‘Cut it and eat from it, and feed (others from it), for Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [22:36] then when they fall down, eat from them and feed’.
en.sarwar: 9. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbat from a slave of abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who has said the following:

“I saw abu al-Hassan, al-Awwal, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ask for a badanah and he slaughtered it. When the butchers cut off its veins and it fell on the ground and they uncovered its hump he (the Imam) told them to get something thereof and eat;
Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has said, ‘When their sides reach the ground eat and feed thereof.’”
